answer: This finds pairs of packages that have resolved calls going in both directions. It uses resolved call records, maps callers and callees to their files, excludes test files, and ignores top-level modules with an empty package name. Each qualifying pair is returned once, with the lexicographically smaller package in the first column.

display_annotations.note: Deterministic display links; not source citations made by the model.

output_contract.guidance: List each pair once, with the lexicographically smaller package in package_a.

question: Which pairs of packages call into each other in both directions?
reference_sql:
WITH edges AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fa.package AS from_package, fb.package AS to_package
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN code.symbols a ON a.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id
  JOIN code.files fa ON fa.file_id = a.file_id
  JOIN code.symbols b ON b.symbol_id = c.callee_symbol_id
  JOIN code.files fb ON fb.file_id = b.file_id
  WHERE fa.package <> fb.package AND NOT fa.is_test AND NOT fb.is_test
)
SELECT e1.from_package AS package_a, e1.to_package AS package_b
FROM edges e1
JOIN edges e2 ON e2.from_package = e1.to_package AND e2.to_package = e1.from_package
WHERE e1.from_package < e1.to_package
ORDER BY package_a, package_b;

request.question:
Which pairs of packages call into each other in both directions?

Requested output columns: package_a (string), package_b (string).

sql: WITH call_edges AS (SELECT DISTINCT caller_file.package AS caller_package, callee_file.package AS callee_package FROM auto_ontology_code.code.calls AS c JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS caller_symbol ON c.caller_symbol_id = caller_symbol.symbol_id JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.files AS caller_file ON caller_symbol.file_id = caller_file.file_id JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS callee_symbol ON c.callee_symbol_id = callee_symbol.symbol_id JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.files AS callee_file ON callee_symbol.file_id = callee_file.file_id WHERE c.resolution IN ('same_file', 'imported', 'method_on_self') AND caller_file.is_test = FALSE AND callee_file.is_test = FALSE AND caller_file.package <> '' AND callee_file.package <> '' AND caller_file.package <> callee_file.package) SELECT DISTINCT e1.caller_package AS package_a, e1.callee_package AS package_b FROM call_edges AS e1 JOIN call_edges AS e2 ON e1.caller_package = e2.callee_package AND e1.callee_package = e2.caller_package WHERE e1.caller_package < e1.callee_package ORDER BY package_a, package_b;
